reviews.text: We've been using their services since our dog was a puppy. They offer training, of course, but they also have plenty of dogs to play with. During the hot summer months, rainy seasons, or when it's difficult to play outside, they take care of our dog and let him play. They also make overnight stays feel like being at home, so we can leave our dog there with complete peace of mind.

Thank you very much for your review.

Our shop is a total care grooming salon.

We also sell dog cakes, original goods, toys, and more, so if you are looking for a pet salon or pet supplies store in the Meguro area, please feel free to visit us. We will continue to strive to improve our services. We appreciate your continued patronage.

I've been using this facility since he was a puppy. They offer a wide variety of services, and I was especially impressed with the kindergarten dog training. Thanks to the teachers, my fidgety dog ​​has become so well-behaved that I can take him anywhere to play. He also used to be a bit shy around other dogs, but now he's made many friends.
He always has other dogs with him when he comes to play at the facility, and when I drop him off and pick him up, he always comes home with a big smile on his face. ^_^

Recently, I've started offering chiropractic treatments in addition to training.
He originally had a stuttering gait with grade 3 patella prolapse, which caused him to have an odd gait. His center of gravity was forward, making him seem like he was stomping around. The staff recommended Medicel (fascia release) treatment, and he started at age 3.
He's been coming every month, and his muscles have grown stronger, and his gait has improved dramatically since starting treatment. ^_^

The staff is very knowledgeable, and this is a truly dog-first facility.

The grooming is always done so smoothly and beautifully. While I'm waiting to pick up my dog, they are very accommodating, letting him play with other dogs and taking good care of him, adapting to his temperament and how well he gets along with them. It's a bit far from my house, but I'm so grateful to be able to use their services.

We always rely on them for grooming, daycare, and events. Their service is polite, and the atmosphere is bright and welcoming. Our dogs love this place so much they want to come in on their own!

They have a variety of dog food, and our dogs absolutely love it! ✨ They seem to really enjoy the cookie treats we get after grooming and daycare; their reaction is amazing! 😂

The pet supplies they stock are all healthy and high-quality, so I highly recommend them! 🫶🏻
Every month she has a very refreshing smile ♡ As expected of Bivish ☺️

This is a very pet-friendly grooming salon that I highly recommend.
In addition to grooming, they offer a full range of pet-related services here, including hotel rooms, food and supplies sales, temporary care, and schooling!

The staff are all friendly with each other and the atmosphere is great. My dog ​​always gets the love he deserves, so it seems like they love Bibish!

Just passing by this place on a walk gets me excited, lol.

With such lovely staff to look after, I feel comfortable leaving my dog ​​at Bibish's pet hotel, even when I travel.

I'm truly glad I chose this salon! I look forward to continuing to use their services!

Everyone has such lovely smiles, and it's such a comfortable place that I always end up staying longer than planned 😊
Even my elderly dog, who is a picky eater when it comes to food and treats, always eats Bibish's cookies and limited-edition menu items, so both the dog and the owner are happy 🎵

The person in charge was very kind and always did such a lovely job, I'm so grateful.

Thank you so much ♡
